primary: effective increments of thread_token_usage, checked equal to per-response usage
total_identity: total_tokens = input_tokens + output_tokens for every inspected usage record
cached_input: reported cached input component; not added to total again
reasoning_output: reported reasoning output component; not added to total again
cache_write_input: all zero in task; nonzero billing semantics not established
stage_attribution: operation/observation time association; not exclusive causal token cost
guardian_billing: unknown whether debited identically or included in product quota
terminal_output_scope: decoded command output fields, separate from raw serialized tool blocks and image data
program_wall_scope: reported online/export/audit sums, not CPU time or task elapsed time
